justification: Inspected the only 6 classes with package declaration exactly `com.google.zxing.oned.rss`: `AbstractRSSReader.java` (142 LOC), `DataCharacter.java` (59), `FinderPattern.java` (65), `Pair.java` (41), `RSS14Reader.java` (471), and `RSSUtils.java` (87), for 865 LOC total. The package is cohesive around one narrow domain (RSS barcode decoding): one main reader, one abstract base, three small value objects, and one utility class. That structure does not show an excessively large or responsibility-heavy package indicative of a God Component.
